record.original_question: What is the smallest degree d for which the punctual Hilbert scheme Hilb_d(A^3, 0), the fiber of the Hilbert-Chow map over d[0], is reducible? The paper records the bounds 12 <= d <= 18.

evidence.quote: Problem III. What is the smallest d for which the punctual Hilbert scheme Hilbd(A^3, 0) is reducible? We have 12 <= d <= 18.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer $d$, let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional subschemes of length $d$ in affine $3$-space $\mathbb{A}^3$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3,0)$ denote the punctual Hilbert scheme, i.e., the fiber over $d\cdot[0]$ of the Hilbert–Chow morphism $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)\to\mathrm{Sym}^d(\mathbb{A}^3)$. Equivalently, $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3,0)$ parametrizes ideals $I\subseteq k[x,y,z]$ such that $\dim_k k[x,y,z]/I = d$ and the only associated prime of $k[x,y,z]/I$ is the maximal ideal $(x,y,z)$.

Determine the smallest positive integer $d$ such that the punctual Hilbert scheme $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3,0)$ is reducible. It is known that this smallest $d$ satisfies $12 \le d \le 18$.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact smallest degree $d$ at which the punctual Hilbert scheme $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3,0)$ becomes reducible is not pinned down in the literature; only bounds (12 ≤ d ≤ 18) are known. Related results on the (non-punctual) Hilbert scheme of points in $\mathbb{A}^3$ (e.g., irreducibility for ≤ 11 points) do not resolve the punctual version. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Hilbert scheme of 11 points in A^3 is irreducible
status_evidence.snippet: Proof that Hilb^{11}(A^3) is irreducible, improving lower bounds on reducibility.
status_evidence.claim: Related (non-punctual) reducibility bounds are studied, but the punctual problem remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Small elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs small elementary (punctual) components, providing upper bounds on the degree of reducibility.
status_evidence.claim: Upper bounds for the smallest reducible punctual Hilbert scheme degree have been improved but the exact value remains unknown.
